categories.main_business_segments: Shanghai Aohua Endoscope Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of electronic endoscope equipment and endoscopic diagnostic and surgical consumables. Its products serve multiple clinical departments including gastroenterology, respiratory, ENT, gynecology, and emergency medicine. The company offers endoscope devices such as image processors, light sources, endoscope bodies, and peripheral equipment, as well as consumables used in endoscopic diagnosis and treatment.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company focuses on core technologies including endoscopic image processing, endoscope body design and integration, and electrical isolation technology. It has developed proprietary technologies such as spectral staining, real-time dimming, 4K low-latency high-definition image processing, miniature imaging modules, low-loss image signal transmission, and laser transmission technology. Production follows strict quality management systems compliant with ISO13485 and involves precision machining and assembly of small, high-precision components.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are hospitals and medical institutions across various clinical departments requiring endoscopic diagnostic and therapeutic solutions. The company serves domestic Chinese markets extensively and has expanded into developed international markets including Germany, the UK, and South Korea. Its products are used in early cancer diagnosis and treatment, particularly in digestive tract diseases.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with a growing presence in international markets such as Germany, the United Kingdom, South Korea, Ireland, and Singapore through subsidiaries and marketing networks. It has established marketing centers in multiple Chinese cities and overseas subsidiaries to support sales and service.
categories.supply_chain_position: Shanghai Aohua Endoscope operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the medical device supply chain, focusing on manufacturing and assembling endoscopic equipment and consumables. It maintains an independent and complete R&D, procurement, production, and sales service system, controlling the full process from product development to after-sales service.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D investment, dedicating over 21% of revenue to research and development, focusing on innovation in 4K ultra-high-definition endoscopy, miniature imaging modules, AI-assisted diagnostics, 3D soft endoscopy, and endoscopic robotics. It aims to enhance product performance, automation, and intelligence, accelerate import substitution, and expand clinical applications. The company also emphasizes talent development and global market expansion.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of endoscopic equipment and consumables. The company employs multiple sales models including distribution (majority), consignment sales, and direct sales to hospitals and ODM customers. It also earns revenue from endoscope maintenance services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with major Japanese multinational firms such as Olympus, Fujifilm, and Pentax Medical, which dominate the global soft electronic endoscope market. Shanghai Aohua Endoscope positions itself as a leading domestic innovator with a growing market share, leveraging advanced technology and expanding product lines to challenge international incumbents and promote import substitution.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company achieved revenue of approximately RMB 678 million, a 52.29% increase year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders rising 167.04% to RMB 57.85 million. Total assets reached RMB 1.595 billion, growing 9.24%, and net assets attributable to shareholders increased 8.85% to RMB 1.38 billion. The company has shown strong growth momentum supported by increased R&D investment and market expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Shanghai Aohua Endoscope emphasizes high-quality, innovative endoscopic solutions with advanced imaging technologies such as 4K ultra-high-definition and spectral staining to improve early cancer detection and diagnostic accuracy. Its products offer multi-platform compatibility, ergonomic design, and enhanced cleaning efficiency (e.g., split-type endoscopes). The company leverages proprietary core technologies and a comprehensive quality management system to deliver reliable, clinically recognized products that meet diverse clinical needs and support minimally invasive procedures.
